what: Only a logo, one line and an Enter button sit in front of two curtains, left and right, covering the hero. On click the button group fades out over .5s ease while the curtains open 105% past either side over 1.5s inCubic. Once open, the button group slides up by its own height over .5s linear — an invitation-like entrance
ease: /  power2.in (curtain, original IX2 inCubic) · cubic-bezier(0.25,0.1,0.25,1) (group disappear) · none (group exit)

options.dur: Length of the curtain opening (seconds), default 1.5 — the group leaves only after this length ends
options.fade: Seconds for the button group to disappear, default 0.5
options.lift: Seconds for the bundle to slide up and out after being drawn back, default 0.5
options.[data-fx-part=left]·[data-fx-part=right]: Left and right curtains (children) — place photos or art inside
options.[data-fx-part=gate]: Logo, one line and button group in front of the curtain (children)
options.[data-fx-part=enter]: Button that opens on press (inside group)
options.fx:open: Event the element emits the moment it is pressed — the consumer inserts the remaining hidden sections into the document here (the original turns on display for the remaining sections at this point)
options.fx:done: Event fired once everything is cleared

use: Introducing

from.where: index.html .x-hero curtain entrance (original IX2 a-22 Opening the curtain)

note: The original curtain is two red velvet photos — the part only reserves the slot and the user decides what goes inside. The entrance opens only when the button is pressed, so in places passed often, like an app’s first screen, use a shorter dur
